verdict.rationale: Kong ships headless/CI-friendly tooling: decK CLI for declarative config automation (verified hands-on install/run), DB-less Docker deployment, RESTful Admin API, and Inso CLI with documented lint/test/export commands designed for CI/CD pipelines. missing for 10: no first-party example of a full CI pipeline (e.g. GitHub Actions YAML) combining these tools end-to-end.
